note: Set B is better because it correctly identifies the quantity of MWL01 units and accurately reports the left segment width in the West Living Elevation (2'-11 3/16"), whereas Set A incorrectly assigns the middle segment width to the left segment. Set A also mislabels the North Living Elevation width (9'-11 1/2") as height, while Set B avoids this error. Both sets confuse North and West Bedroom dimensions, but Set B has fewer clear dimension attribute swaps.
